title: Affine basic-open localization chart
statement: For a commutative ring R, g in R and any natural n, put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:Spec A to Spec R, and V=D(algebraMap R A g), using def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions. There exist a commutative ring S, phi:R to S and e:Spec S isomorphic to V such that e followed by the inclusion and q is Spec phi, and phi(g) is a unit.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, off-divisor branch; standard basic-open localization and monic root algebra calculation

proof.text: Set h=algebraMap R A g and S=Localization.Away h, with phi the composite algebra map. Use the inverse of Mathlib basicOpenIsoSpecAway h as e.

The basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap identity, composed with the inverse isomorphism, gives compatibility with the localization map. Contravariance of Spec and composition of ring maps yield the required equation over R. IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit h proves invertibility of phi(g).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYG motivates the off-divisor application; the explicit algebraic and scheme argument is written here and completely checked by Lean.
